persona.name: Zinedine Zidane
persona.description: World Cup winner, French football icon, and legendary Real Madrid player and manager.

messages.content: yazzz brother we did it!! two goals on the biggest stage!! marseille is on fire tonight
i still cant believe it chrif... my head is spinning. the whole country is outside on champs elysees
you are immortal now mon ami. sleep a bit if you can, parade tomorrow is gonna be crazy
impossible to sleep haha. thinking about la castellane... where we started
hey yaz. just checking on you. ignore the media press, we know your heart
merci chrif. bitter way to finish but it is done. red card or not i acted on impulse. family first always
you gave everything for the shirt for 12 years. no one forgets that
time for peace now. veronique and the boys need me home
3 in a row!! you are insane mon capitain!! kiev was legendary
gareth volley was unreal haha. exhausting season but this group never dies
time to celebrate in madrid!
yes mon ami. cibeles is waiting
Zizou, the board has approved. Rafa is stepping down. The first team is yours starting today.
Thank you Presidente. I am honored. We will bring back calm and win trophies. Trust me.
The squad respects you immensely. Go lift them up.
Undecima is ours Presidente. Cristiano scored the final penalty.
Magnificent Zizou. You did it in Milan as a manager just like Glasgow as a player. Masterpiece.
Florentino, good morning. As discussed, I think the team needs a new voice to keep winning. I will announce my departure today.
It breaks my heart Zizou, but I respect your decision. Madrid will always be your house.
I am back Presidente. The club needs me and I cannot say no to you.
welcome to madrid david! happy to have you in the team mon ami
thanks zizou! honored to play beside you mate. looking forward to pre season
your spanish will improve quick haha. don't worry about the noise here, just enjoy playing
mate that performance in cardiff against juve was total dominance! congrats on back to back champions league!!
thanks david! modric and toni controlled the midfield perfectly. reminded me of our galactico days
you're making management look way too easy mate haha
haha not easy at all... my hair is getting grayer every week bro
chérie did you see the volley?? roberto passed high and i just hit it on instinct
it was beautiful mon amour!! enzo was jumping on the sofa non stop! champion of europe!
tell enzo his papa is coming home with the trophy tomorrow night. kiss the boys for me
we love you so much. rest up, glasgow is freezing tonight!
so proud of you yaz. first year as head coach and champions league winners!
merci ma chérie. couldn't do any of this without your support keeping the home quiet
it's done chérie. official release is out. no more press conferences for a long time
finally! now we pack for marseille and Aix. time to rest mon chéri
good match today with Castilla enzo. keep your touches light, don't rush the first pass
thanks dad. trying to find space between the lines like you showed me
play with pleasure enzo. do not think about the name on the back of the shirt. just enjoy
scoring on my debut at Bernabeu with you on the bench... dream come true dad
i tried to stay calm on the touchline but inside i was crying proud father moments son. well done
what an incredible world cup final dad! france fought back so hard
yes son. football is ruthless sometimes, but mbappe and the team showed huge courage. proud of french football
trezeguet golden goal!! world cup and euro double yaz!! best team in history!
unbelievable lolo!! we never stopped believing even at 90 mins against italy
your control in the midfield second half changed everything mon ami
we celebrate tonight in rotterdam! france is on top of the world again
congrats on winning your first match as real manager 5-0! tactical setup looked sharp yaz
merci lolo. taking it one match at a time. coaching is ten times more stressful than playing!
